name: Girl Friends
source:
Eight girls went on a beach trip. Our guy, as one girl's classmate, tag along to take some pictures. To get their topless picture, he has to do something interesting. To get their nude picture, they have to love him a bit at least. Will he be able to find a girlfriend after their 3 day trip?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
八名女孩一起去海边旅行。主人公作为其中一人的同班同学也跟了过去，负责给她们拍照。想拍到她们的裸露上身照，他就得做些有趣的事；想拍到裸体照，则至少要让她们对自己产生一点好感。三天旅行结束后，他能找到女朋友吗？

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
